newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares recover from lows on Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares recover from lows on Greenspan.

text.p: 1525 GMT - Shares were recovering from session lows after Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony to the Senate Budget Committee which seemed to contain no negative messages for the markets, traders said.
*The .PSI20 index was down 0.46 percent at 5,697.34 against a low of 5,638.06.
